fields.name: Kenyan Dark Chocolate
fields.description: Rich single-origin dark chocolate from Mount Kenya estates, slow-churned with a hint of espresso and sea salt. Velvety smooth finish.

fields.name: Mango Maziwa
fields.description: Fresh Malindi mangoes blended with creamy whole milk and a dash of cardamom. Tastes like a Kenyan summer afternoon.

fields.name: Passion & Hibiscus Sorbet
fields.description: Zero-dairy sorbet of wild passion fruit and dried hibiscus flowers. Tangy, floral, and utterly refreshing.

fields.name: Vanilla Bean Royale
fields.description: Tahitian vanilla beans steeped in fresh cream overnight. Classic, pure, and utterly indulgent.

fields.name: Salted Caramel Savanna
fields.description: House-made caramel with Maldon sea salt, swirled through Madagascar cream. Our best-seller since 2015.

fields.name: Baobab & Coconut
fields.description: Baobab superfruit powder meets creamy coconut milk for a dairy-free tropical dream with a subtle citrus note.

fields.name: Strawberry Masai
fields.description: Locally grown Limuru strawberries blended with a drizzle of raw acacia honey. Fresh, bright, and seasonal.

fields.name: Matcha Forest
fields.description: Ceremonial-grade Japanese matcha blended with sweetened condensed milk. Earthy, complex, beautiful.

fields.name: Lemon Zest Sherbet
fields.description: Bright East African lemons, a pinch of turmeric, and cane sugar make this a zingy palate cleanser.

fields.name: Black Sesame Midnight
fields.description: Toasted black sesame paste swirled through premium cream. Deep, nutty, and hauntingly beautiful.

fields.name: Avocado Dream
fields.description: Creamy Kenyan Hass avocado with a squeeze of lime and condensed milk. Rich, lush, and utterly unique.

fields.name: Rose & Cardamom Kulfi
fields.description: Inspired by South Asian kulfi — dense, slow-frozen with rose water, pistachios, and cardamom. A cultural gem.
